items.text: The remote will cost 12.50 Euro to produce.
The remote will sell for 25 Euro.
The remote will feature an ergonomic design.
The team will not work with teletext.
The remote will only control televisions.
The corporate image must be recognizable on the remote.
The remote will have a power button.
The remote will have a small joystick.
The remote will have LCD.
Instead of an "okay" button, the user will push down on the joystick.
The remote will have a beeping noise which goes off when a user is trying to locate it.
The remote will use a lithium battery.
The remote will have a double curved design. (replaces a single curved case)
The remote will have a case made of rubber. (replaces a wooden case)
The remote will be yellow.

items.text: A locator device separate from the remote will be incorporated into the design, which will operate with radio signal.
Speech recognition will not be used.
The group decided that their target marketing group would be mostly teenagers and young professionals.
There will not be a stand in which the remote is placed when not in use.
The group decided that the locator function eliminated the need for this component. (replaces a remote without a locator function)
The locator function will not involve an LED indicator; the remote will simply emit a sound when located.
The main interface will include a power button.
The main interface will include a scroll wheel function in place of a number pad.
The remote will feature a spongy material.
The fruits and vegetables trend will be incorporated into the design by including fruit colors along with the company colors. (replaces a remote without the corporate image)
The remote will feature a changeable outer casing.

items.text: The group will discuss the design plans of the three experts at the next meeting.
The group will first work on a functional design of the device.
The group will discuss which features to include in and eliminate from the final design of the product at the next meeting.
The remote will have a slim shape and a simple interface, include a locator function and voice recognition, and be made of a hard material.
The group decided on the features that will be included in the final design of the prototype.

The remote will have customized wood casing and ergonomic sizing, voice recognition, a locator function, rubber buttons in a simple arrangement, an advanced chip, and a battery life indicator. (replaces a simple chip)

The group discussed including a display on the remote, but the prototype will be designed without a display until the Marketing Expert finds out how much it would cost to add it. (replaces a remote without a screen)
The group decided to contact another company to manufacture the product that could do it cheaply yet still paid fair wages.

items.text: The group decided to make the remote a universal remote.
The remote will not feature speech recognition or an LCD screen.
The remote will light up when a button is pressed, much like a mobile phone.
The remote will feature teletext capabilities, and the teletext buttons will be included on the main interface.
The group decided to use a scroll button for volume control.
It will be small and yellow, to use one of the colors of the Real Reaction logo.
The remote will include rechargeable batteries and will be used with a recharging stand. (replaces a remote without a recharging dock)
The remote will feature plastic buttons and casing, rather than rubber.
The remote will not feature an LCD screen.
The remote will feature a double-curved, rounded square design.
The group decided to design five changeable faces for the device.
They eventually decided to incorporate speech recognition and an advanced chip. (replaces a remote without speech recognition)

items.text: The product will be sold at 25 Euros.
The aim is to seel 50 million Euros.
The production cost should be half the selling price.
To get started they will assume the remote to be for TV and video, and reserve the possibility to add features.
The remote will have an LCD screen and speech recognition.
The advanced functions such as audio settings, contrast and channel programming will be accessed through the screen.
The target group will be aged 16-40.
A teletext option will not be included. (replaces including teletext)
The remote will be for TV only.
The remote will feature the corporate logo and colour.
The screen and microphone will be at the top of the remote.
There will be LEDs under the buttons so that buttons in use will light up.
The remote will use kinetic energy. (replaces solar power)
The case will be double-curved and made of rubber.
The remote will use an advanced chip.
